initiative.title: Realm creation from a drop
initiative.body: Drop assets, images and documents on openagents.com and get a complete project card, roadmap and first realm, reviewed by the owner before it's public.

milestones.title: From a drop to a published project
milestones.body: The drop area, the agent's draft, the owner's review and publishing without a deploy.

tasks.title: NEW PROJECT on /projects: a drop area for assets, images and documents
tasks.body:
A drop area drawn in Coax on /projects (and on a project's own page for later drops): files of any kind, with progress, limits on size and type, stored privately until published.

Design: `docs/projects/new-project.md` Part 2.
acceptance: Dropping documents, images, audio and 3D files works on desktop; picking files works on a phone
Drops are private to their owner until published

tasks.title: An agent reads a drop and drafts the project
tasks.body:
An agent reads everything dropped and drafts the project card (name, one line, owner, cover, art direction), the design document in the owner's words with open questions, the roadmap as milestones and tasks with acceptance checks, and an asset inventory with licences. Google-first model routing.

Design: `docs/projects/new-project.md` Part 2.
acceptance: From the Planetary Villa notes alone, the draft covers every mechanic Kiki described
Each drafted task has acceptance checks a reviewer could run

tasks.title: The draft names the engine upgrades the design needs
tasks.body:
The agent compares the design with what the Verse engine can do and drafts linked engine tasks (reusing existing ones), with `needs` on the waiting tasks.

Design: `docs/projects/new-project.md` Part 2.
acceptance: Run on the Planetary Villa notes, it finds the engine needs the manual setup found

tasks.title: The owner reviews and corrects the draft before anything is public
tasks.body:
A review view: the card, design, roadmap and links side by side, every field editable, with PUBLISH and DISCARD. Nothing reaches the relay or the bucket before PUBLISH.

Design: `docs/projects/new-project.md` Part 2.
acceptance: The owner can change any field and the published project matches the edits
DISCARD leaves no trace in public

tasks.title: Publish: key, Nostr events, assets, page and listing
tasks.body:
On PUBLISH the site makes the project's key (held for the owner until their account takes it), publishes the 30621 project and its work, stores the assets, and the project appears on /projects with its page, without a code change or a release.

Design: `docs/projects/new-project.md` Part 2.
acceptance: A project created from a drop is live at /projects/<slug> without a deploy
Its key never leaves the server unencrypted

tasks.title: A first realm from the drop's assets
tasks.body:
The dropped 3D assets, textures and sounds placed in an empty realm so the project has somewhere to walk on day one, linked from its card.

Design: `docs/projects/new-project.md` Part 2.
acceptance: A drop with models produces a walkable realm with them placed

tasks.title: Later drops grow a project, as proposals the owner accepts
tasks.body:
A drop on an existing project's page becomes proposed changes (new tasks, design notes, assets) that the owner accepts or declines.

Design: `docs/projects/new-project.md` Part 2.
acceptance: A second drop on Planetary Villa proposes changes and accepting them updates the page
